tagline.en_US: An open-source authentication and authorization server for protecting web applications. This single-image profile provides a local SQLite database and file notifications; configure your domain, reverse proxy and access rules before protecting other services.

description.en_US: Authelia is an authentication and authorization server that provides two-factor authentication and single sign-on for web applications. Working in conjunction with reverse proxies, it evaluates incoming HTTP requests to allow, deny, or redirect them based on configurable security policies. It supports multi-factor authentication through hardware security keys, time-based one-time passwords, mobile push notifications, and passkeys.
